verified.entry_point: The reported crash reproduces at the pinned commit through v.safeParse of a collection schema followed by v.flatten: a submitted entry named like an inherited object member throws TypeError. Every other tested route was driven through the public exports (safeParse/safeParseAsync over collection, strict, catch-all, pass-through and combination schemas; the issue-reporting helpers).
